current_clock.meaning: Current local chrony evidence; not independent absolute-time proof

limitations: Local supplement monitor has no separate external notification integration.
Existing original-cohort remote watchdog continues monitoring the host heartbeat.
Supplement branch pushes do not invoke the original main-branch CI workflow.
Candle windows follow actual process start, not scheduled time.
Overlapping candle rows are deduplicated by identity, not independent observations.
Failed, missed, blocked and pending original slots remain unchanged references.
Clock legacy offset_seconds is invalid; use retained clock-corrections.json where available.
Local evidence verification does not establish independent timestamp proof or profitability.
view.scope: Read-only operational observations; original 30-slot report remains separate
